basis: Confirmed-fill gross minus actual incurred native fees plus native held-PnL endpoint interpolation. Prequote snapshots apply fills strictly earlier than timestamp. First held native snapshot equity is denominator, not exact decision equity. Conditional adverse uses perasset OHLC endpoint; no synchronized joint path. Excludes unallocated signed funding. Descriptive screens are not stop execution or counterfactual ROI. Winner final net at risk includes full completed episode, not future PnL after trigger. First-held exposure can be tiny first partial fill and is not full intended admission or add-time exposure.

temporal_parent_map.basis: Latest native BTC entry before SOL episode first fill; inferred chronological parent, not archived immutable domain UUID; rights may persist after physical BTC flat. No causal skipped-parent ROI.

running_episode_profit_peak_giveback: MEASURED cumulative native attributed episode close peak minus later held-close path; peak timestamp not retained, trough UTC retained; denominator first-held portfolio equity, not profit-peak return.
